papers.title: Topological design and synergistic enhancement mechanism of mechanical and thermal properties for hybrid TPMS lattice structures based on shear band suppression

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究混合TPMS点阵结构的力学性能设计，虽未涉及生物医学植入物，但其拓扑优化和力学增强机制对多孔植入物的刚度匹配设计具有借鉴意义。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, bone-implant interface, or biomedical context; it focuses on mechanical and thermal properties of lattice structures for general engineering applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 为提升点阵结构力学与热学性能，探索混合TPMS拓扑设计。
summary_zh.method: 通过拓扑设计混合TPMS结构，利用剪切带抑制机制增强性能。
summary_zh.result: 混合TPMS结构在力学和热学性能上表现出协同增强效果。
summary_zh.validation: 基于数值模拟验证，未进行实验测试。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance both mechanical and thermal performance of lattice structures, this study explores hybrid TPMS topologies.
summary_en.method: The authors design hybrid TPMS lattice structures and leverage shear band suppression to achieve synergistic property enhancement.
summary_en.result: The hybrid TPMS structures exhibit improved mechanical and thermal properties compared to single topologies.
summary_en.validation: The study relies on numerical simulations without experimental validation.

papers.title: Vat Polymerization 3D Printing of Hydrogels With Tunable Porosity.
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional, interconnected hydrogel networks are central to tissue engineering and disease modeling, where tailored pore architecture and mechanical robustness are essential for supporting cellular functions. However, the limited ability to engineer microstructural features in vat polymerization 3D-printed natural hydrogels often compromises scaffold performance, as oversized pores reduce cell attachment and cell-cell interactions while smooth pore walls lack essential topographical cues. Here, we report an emulsion-based ink for vat polymerization 3D printing that enables the fabrication of hydrogels with finely tunable and highly interconnected porous architectures. An oil-in-water resin formulated using gelatin methacrylate (GelMA) contains stable solvent nanodroplets that act as sacrificial templates during photopolymerization. Removal of the dispersed phase yields additive-free porous hydrogels with pore sizes ranging from 0.66 to 46.15 µm and a 2.5-fold enhancement in compressive toughness. This strategy is compatible with digital light processing (DLP) and broadly applicable to multiple photocurable biopolymers, including alginate methacrylate (ALMA) and hyaluronic acid methacrylate (HAMA). The resulting porous scaffolds promote enhanced cell attachment, proliferation, and cell-cell interactions, highlighting the potential of this vat polymerization-compatible platform for advanced biofabrication.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及生物打印中的水凝胶制造，但未涉及AI或机器学习，因此与AI生物打印方向的相关性较低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate any AI/ML techniques into the bioprinting workflow, nor does it address autonomous decision-making or intelligent process control.

summary_zh.motivation: 为组织工程制造具有可调孔隙结构的水凝胶支架。
summary_zh.method: 利用油包水乳液作为牺牲模板，通过光聚合打印多孔水凝胶。
summary_zh.result: 实现了0.66-46.15微米的可调孔径，压缩韧性提高2.5倍，并促进细胞附着和增殖。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验验证了支架的生物相容性。

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate hydrogel scaffolds with tunable porous architectures for tissue engineering applications.
summary_en.method: An emulsion-based ink with sacrificial nanodroplets is used in vat polymerization to create interconnected pores.
summary_en.result: Pore sizes ranging from 0.66 to 46.15 µm were achieved, with a 2.5-fold increase in compressive toughness and enhanced cell interactions.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture experiments confirmed improved cell attachment and proliferation on the porous scaffolds.

papers.title: A low-cost imaging platform for quantitative characterisation of scaffold surface macrotopography with potential application in craniofacial tissue engineering.
papers.abstract: Craniofacial bone regeneration is a demanding application of tissue engineering (TE) in which scaffold architecture-pore size, shape and spatial distribution-is a determinant of regenerative success, so that reliable geometric quality control is a prerequisite for translation. Conventional assessment of printed scaffold geometry is largely manual, time-consuming and subject to operator variability. Here we present a low-cost, semi-automated imaging platform that combines custom 3D-printed hardware-a 12.3 MP Raspberry Pi High Quality Camera with a 6 mm CS-mount lens, an adjustable monopod and a ring illuminator-with a dedicated image-processing pipeline. The system acquires a single zenithal image of a scaffold and segments it to quantify the number, area, perimeter and compactness of the pores of the uppermost printed layer; it therefore characterises two-dimensional surface macrotopography and does not resolve internal three-dimensional architecture or pore interconnectivity. On a printed reference grid the platform was highly repeatable (coefficient of variation, CV = 1.33%) but systematically underestimated pore area by 11.6%, a reproducible bias that can be removed by calibration. On a 3D-printed PLA scaffold, repeated acquisitions agreed to within CV = 0.01-2.48% (N = 5), whereas manual measurement of the same specimen by three experienced operators gave an inter-user CV of 11.5-22.8% and an intra-user CV of 0-12.7%. Feasibility was further demonstrated on two silica-gelatin hybrid bioink scaffolds and on a silica-based scaffold with non-linear pore boundaries. The total hardware cost is approximately €170. By reducing user-dependent variability under the conditions tested, and at a cost accessible to standard laboratories, the platform provides a practical quality-control tool for scaffold fabrication, with potential application to craniofacial tissue engineering.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种低成本的半自动成像平台用于支架表面形貌表征，虽未直接集成AI，但其图像处理流程可迁移至生物打印的质量控制环节。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI/ML into the bioprinting workflow; it uses a simple image-processing pipeline without machine learning, and lacks autonomous decision-making or experimental validation of biological outcomes.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统支架几何评估耗时且主观，需要低成本自动化质控工具。
summary_zh.method: 结合3D打印硬件与图像处理流水线，从单张图像量化孔隙参数。
summary_zh.result: 平台重复性高，误差可校准，优于人工测量。
summary_zh.validation: 通过参考网格和3D打印支架验证，并与人工测量对比。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional scaffold geometry assessment is manual and subjective, necessitating a low-cost automated quality control tool.
summary_en.method: A custom 3D-printed imaging platform with a Raspberry Pi camera and an image-processing pipeline quantifies pore metrics from a single zenithal image.
summary_en.result: The platform demonstrated high repeatability (CV=1.33% on reference grid) and reduced inter-user variability compared to manual measurements.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed on printed reference grids and 3D-printed scaffolds, with comparisons to manual measurements by multiple operators.
